scene: Japanese and Chinese virtual-singer music: Vocaloid and voice-synthesis producers, VTuber and virtual idol acts performing as characters, and utaite who came up through that scene. Relevant events are live shows, concerts, DJ sets, orchestral or arrangement programs, and fan-run gatherings centered on this music — not general anime conventions, cosplay events, or Japanese cultural programming that merely overlaps the audience.
